children: According to the announcement from Binance, Binance Earn has added new offers to Yield Arena this week, expanding its lineup across Simple Earn, ETH Staking, SOL Staking, Dual Investment, and related earning products. The update includes limited-time opportunities for eligible users in several categories, with rewards tied to specific subscription periods and product types. Under Earn Spotlight Limited-Time Offers, users who hold at least 0.01 USDe for 24 hours can receive 4.75% APR rewards from 2026-09-04 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-09-10 23:59 (UTC). In Simple Earn, users who subscribe to USDT Flexible Products from 2026-09-08 00:00:00 (UTC) to 2026-09-22 23:59:59 (UTC) may receive up to 7% APR, including an exclusive Bonus Tiered APR. The announcement also says users who confirm participation in the Simple Earn Leaderboard and subscribe to ETH Flexible Products and PLUME Flexible or Locked Products from 2026-09-01 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-09-20 23:59 (UTC) will share $200K worth of BNB Rewards.

The announcement also outlines additional product offerings across flexible, locked, staking, and dual investment categories. Flexible Products include USDC, U, U for VIP users, ETH, SOL, and KGST, each with listed real-time APRs and bonus tiered APR structures. Locked Products include BNB for 7 days, SOL for 90 days, SOL for VIP users over 60 days, BTC for VIP users over 60 days, BABY, 0G, SSV, and GRAM, with APRs ranging from 0.35% plus airdrop rewards to 20% in ETH rewards. ETH Staking offers dynamic APR up to 2.3%, while SOL Staking offers dynamic APR up to 4.8%. Dual Investment products are available for BTC and ETH with multiple settlement dates and APRs of 15% or more. The announcement also notes that users holding BNB Flexible Products and/or BNB Locked Products positions may receive ongoing Launchpool rewards, may accrue scores for Megadrop rewards with active BNB Locked Products positions, and may receive airdropped tokens via HODLer Airdrops when subscribing to BNB Simple Earn products.

title: Binance Earn Adds New Yield Arena Offers Across Simple Earn, Staking, and Dual Investment
